data.title: 史尔特尔 · 暮色咖啡角的香草轻尝
data.action: 坐在高脚凳上单手拿小银勺吃香草冰淇淋，微眯赤眸瞥向镜头
data.location: 罗德岛后勤甲板观景咖啡角
data.lighting: 赤金斜光越过铆钉舷窗照到杯沿和细绑带，吧台吊灯只亮一小圈
data.description: 罗德岛后勤甲板咖啡角，宽大的观景舷窗外掠过苍茫荒原与翻滚的赤金晚霞。史尔特尔坐在高脚转椅上，一手握着小银勺轻尝高脚杯里的香草冰淇淋，赤红眼眸微微瞥来，冷漠外表下透着难得的松弛——「看什么看。冰淇淋快化了。博士……要是敢抢我的甜点，我就用烈火把你烤熟。」
data.promptProse: At the Rhodes Island observation counter, Surtr sits on a swivelling bar stool and lifts a small silver spoon from a tall glass of vanilla ice cream. She glances sideways as the last sunlight catches the glass stem, the metal zipper and the crimson mesh of her separate black leather set. A small copper lamp warms the counter behind her. The broad ship window has a deep riveted frame. Outside, the horizon runs over empty dry hills and low dust beneath a band of fiery sunset cloud.
data.animaCaption: At the ship's high counter she lifts a spoonful of vanilla ice cream beside a tall glass dish, looking across the spoon toward the viewer. The riveted observation window opens onto long rows of low hills under a copper dusk.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a two-piece ensemble of soft black faux leather and crimson mesh with crossed waist straps and a small metal front zipper.
